## Domaxing for Windows

Download **Domaxing-Setup-x.y.z.exe** below, run it, and Domaxing gets its own window, Start Menu entry and desktop shortcut.

- Works fully offline. Your tasks are stored on your computer.
- The same app as the [web version](https://yanaannt.github.io/domaxing/), with no browser needed.

**Windows SmartScreen:** the installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
